Class RadialLayout

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.RadialLayout
public final class RadialLayout extends Object
RADIAL writes rings around the selected intent. No selection keeps the positions already stored.

    • place

      public void place(GraphModel model, String selectedIntent)

    • place

      public void place(GraphModel model, String selectedIntent, int points)
      The method writes rings at this point size. A missing selection keeps the seats already stored. The selected intent sits at the origin. Its meat words sit on a halo around that origin. The first ring is the neighborhood. The next ring is the meat words of that neighborhood. Each later hop takes the next ring.
      Parameters:
      model - The model supplies the ids.
      selectedIntent - The selected intent sits at the origin.
      points - The points are the seated font size.
